visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and black-rimmed glasses is shown in a medium shot against a colorful Disney-themed graphic background featuring Snow White and the Evil Queen. She holds a smartphone and looks down at it curiously while wearing a white t-shirt. (2) The background changes to a digital interface for a 'Snow White Psychological Test.' Input fields for name and birthdate appear over a soft floral background. The woman taps on her phone, looking focused and engaged. (3) A series of quiz question screens appear. Each screen has a large question text at the top and several rounded choice buttons below. The woman reacts to each question with varying facial expressions, including skepticism and nodding. (4) After several questions, a detailed results page is displayed. It features a large title 'Love Escape Champion' and a radar chart. The woman smiles broadly, pointing at her phone and the camera as she discusses her result. (5) She continues to hold the phone, showing the results screen while providing a final summary. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean, studio-like aesthetic throughout the video.
